common.name: Your name

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Set up your restaurant's console. You'll confirm your email next.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: We've sent a 6-digit code to the address below. It can take a minute to arrive.
verifyEmail.existing: Already have an account with this address?

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back to Radd Menu.
signIn.methods: How do you want to sign in?
signIn.codeSent: If there's an account for <email>{address}</email>, a sign-in code is on its way.
signIn.codeTwoFactorNote: Using an authenticator app? Sign in with your password instead.
signIn.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.

twoFactorChallenge.title: Two-step verification
twoFactorChallenge.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a code to choose a new password.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter the code we sent to your email and choose a new password. You'll be signed out on every device.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.statusOn: On. When you sign in with your password, we'll also ask for a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.statusOff: Off. Add a code from an authenticator app to your password for extra protection.
twoFactor.scanHelp: Open your authenticator app and scan this code. If you can't scan it, enter the setup key by hand.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.backupHelp: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again, so copy them or write them down now.

invitation.title: Join {organization}
invitation.declined: You declined the invitation. You can close this page.
invitation.signedOutBody: Sign in, or create an account, with the email address the invitation was sent to. You'll come back here afterwards.

backupCode.too_big: That's longer than a backup code.

errors.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email address first. Enter the code we email you.
errors.invalidCode: That code isn't right. Check the latest email from us and try again.
errors.codeExpired: That code has expired. Send a new one and try again.

errors.unavailable: Radd Menu is having trouble right now. Try again in a few minutes.
